title.zh: Gemini 4 Carbon：我们的下一代前沿模型
title.en: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model

current_state.zh:
谷歌 DeepMind 发布了其下一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，称其在编程、智能体任务和网络安全方面取得“显著提升”。谷歌表示，该模型在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数（v5.0）上排名第一，领先于 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 5.5 和 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra。

谷歌将 Carbon 定位为一项被广泛引用的综合基准上的领先者，该基准按智能体、编程、通用能力和科学推理四类加权评分，谷歌称其领先于所提及的两款竞品旗舰模型。

根据谷歌的公告，Gemini 4 Carbon 的上市价格与 Argon 相同：每百万输入 token 2 美元、每百万输出 token 10 美元，缓存输入 token 按输入价格的 95% 折扣计费。谷歌称内部团队已看到该模型在复杂的多步骤工程任务中“连续运行数天、坚持突破死胡同”；同时部分第三方报道称，此前关于该模型的消息基于内部测试。
current_state.en:
Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon, its next frontier model, claiming "significant gains" in coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity. Google says the model takes the top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (v5.0), ahead of Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 and OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra.

Google is positioning Carbon as the leader on a widely cited composite benchmark that weighs agents, coding, general capability and scientific reasoning, placing it ahead of the two rival flagship models it names.

According to Google's announcement, Gemini 4 Carbon launches at the same introductory price as Argon — $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens at 95% off the input price. Google says internal teams have seen the model "run for days to persist through dead ends" on complex, multi-step engineering tasks, while some third-party coverage has described earlier reporting on the model as based on internal testing.

updates.background_zh: 在谷歌的模型序列中，Gemini 4 Carbon 紧随 Argon 之后；社区评论者指出，Argon 在发布被推迟之前就已对外公布，这加剧了外界对哪些模型真正可用的困惑。Artificial Analysis 智能指数是对生产环境基准分数的加权平均，按 0 到 100 缩放，智能体、编程、通用能力和科学推理各占 25%。
updates.background_en: Gemini 4 Carbon follows Argon in Google's lineup; community commenters note that Argon was announced before its release was delayed, adding to confusion about which models are actually available. The Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index is a weighted average of production benchmark scores scaled from 0 to 100, with agents, coding, general capability and scientific reasoning each contributing 25%.
updates.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 的评论者普遍对谷歌的模型命名与分层感到不满，称难以判断哪个 Gemini 模型是最新的，Pro、Ultra 等层级如何对应具体套餐，以及如何在 Workspace 账户上开通。有人主张，在竞争对手迭代如此之快的情况下，只公布基准分数而不公开发布模型毫无意义；还有人建议全行业统一采用 Ultra、Pro、Flash、Lite 这类层级标签。
updates.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters were largely frustrated with Google's model naming and tiering, saying it is unclear which Gemini model is current, how tiers like Pro and Ultra map to plans, and how to sign up on a Workspace account. Several argued that publishing benchmark scores without a public release is meaningless given how fast rivals ship, and one proposed standardizing tier labels such as Ultra, Pro, Flash and Lite across the industry.
updates.market_impact_zh: 对加密市场的传导路径是间接且情绪驱动的：头部 AI 实验室的模型发布会影响 AI 主题代币的叙事，包括去中心化算力与推理市场以及智能体相关项目，其估值往往随前沿 AI 的“势头”感知而波动。公告本身并不涉及对数字资产的直接托管、流动性或监管联系。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path to crypto is indirect and sentiment-driven: model launches from leading AI labs feed the narrative around AI-themed tokens, including decentralized compute and inference marketplaces and agent-related projects, whose valuations often react to perceived momentum in frontier AI. There is no direct custody, liquidity or regulatory linkage to digital assets in the announcement itself.
